internal_sources.policy: Exact OSM feature ID only; merge supported tags.
Exact source_id = accepted OSM feature ID only.
Exact OSM feature ID only; supplemental building fields.
Exact building_osm_id only; photo references are not presumed verified.
Consulted existing linkage audit; no spatial-only candidate copied.

matching_policy: Only rows already linked by accepted centroid-containment or exact-ID methods were enriched. Candidate-only/proximity-review rows were not assigned tags. Coordinates, geometry, source IDs and render heights were not changed.
photo_policy: 184 existing facade-photo-review.csv entries link to accepted OSM IDs; rows are flagged as unverified photo candidates. This is not confirmation that the image shows the target facade, nor permission to assign a texture.
limitations: This is the OpenFreeMap component registry, not yet the direct reconciliation of the 22,977-feature master GeoJSON and 24,102-row master CSV.
The 1,721 records are polygon components, not confirmed distinct physical buildings.
Exact OSM tag linkage is not the same as photo-confirmed architectural identity.
